en_title: Secretlab Reveals K/DA Firestarter Collection With New Gaming Chair and Desk Designs
subtitle: 火焰席卷战位
opus_summary: Secretlab推出K/DA《Firestarter》联名桌椅系列，为Titan Evo电竞椅和Magnus Pro电竞桌带来特别版设计。新品现已开售，提供多种尺寸与配件，K/DA还将登上今年《英雄联盟》全球总决赛舞台。

paragraphs.en: In the wake of K/DA’s Firestarter comeback , Secretlab has revealed a new gaming furniture collection themed after the virtual girl group.
paragraphs.cn: 随着虚拟女团K/DA携《Firestarter》回归，Secretlab公布了一套以该组合为主题的新款游戏家具系列。

paragraphs.en: The collection features new special-edition designs for two of Secretlab’s most popular products: the Titan Evo gaming chair and the Magnus Pro gaming desk. Both battlestation items are decorated with burgundy flames and this era’s K/DA insignia, including symbols for each member: Kai'Sa, Ahri, Akali, and Evelynn.
paragraphs.cn: 该系列为Secretlab最受欢迎的两款产品带来了特别版设计，分别是Titan Evo电竞椅和Magnus Pro电竞桌。两款战位家具都饰有酒红色火焰与这一时期的K/DA标志，其中还包括每位成员的专属符号：Kai'Sa、Ahri、Akali和Evelynn。

paragraphs.en: The full Secretlab x K/DA Firestarter collection is now available for purchase on the Secretlab site with optional add-ons and multiple sizes. The K/DA edition Titan EVO starts at $644 , while the flaming Magnus Pro desk starts at $978 .
paragraphs.cn: Secretlab×K/DA《Firestarter》完整系列现已在Secretlab官网开售，提供可选配件和多种尺寸。K/DA特别版Titan EVO起售价为644美元(约合人民币4302元)，火焰主题Magnus Pro电竞桌起售价为978美元(约合人民币6533元)。

paragraphs.en: The new K/DA Firestarter collection is joining Secretlab's ridiculously long list of League of Legends-themed peripherals , including two existing collections for the girl group's previous eras.
paragraphs.cn: 这套全新的K/DA《Firestarter》系列加入了Secretlab那份长得离谱的《英雄联盟》主题外设清单，其中还包括该女团此前两个时期推出的系列。

paragraphs.en: The base model of the Secretlab Titan Evo is one of our favorite gaming chairs on the market. The racing-style chair sports an adjustable L-Adapt lumbar support system and a sizable “waterfall edge” seat design to improve blood flow. IGN’s reviewer, Chris Coke, spent two years with it as his main gaming chair to offer deeper insight, and found it “be the all-around best option, balancing ergonomics, style, and features that have since changed the gaming chair industry.”
paragraphs.cn: Secretlab Titan Evo基础款是我们最喜欢的游戏椅之一。这款赛车风格电竞椅配备可调节的L-Adapt腰部支撑系统，并采用宽大的「瀑布边缘」座椅设计，以改善血液循环。IGN评测者Chris Coke将它作为主力电竞椅使用了两年，并据此进行了更深入的体验，最终认为它「整体而言是最佳选择，在人体工学、风格和功能之间取得了平衡，而这些功能后来改变了电竞椅行业」。

paragraphs.en: The K/DA design features the Firestarter era's purple flames alongside the Secretlab and K/DA logos. The front of the chair shows each member’s symbols, with silver decals along the edges. The Firestarter edition is available in both Regular ($644) and XL ($714) sizing.
paragraphs.cn: K/DA特别版采用《Firestarter》时期的紫色火焰，并搭配Secretlab和K/DA标志。椅子正面展示了每位成员的专属符号，边缘则饰有银色贴花。《Firestarter》特别版提供标准尺寸和XL尺寸，售价分别为644美元(约合人民币4302元)和714美元(约合人民币4770元)。

paragraphs.en: The Magnus Pro is also our top pick for gaming-dedicated desks . In the words of IGN’s reviewer , Mark Knapp, the latest model “combines the metal desktop and versatile cable organization of the original desk with powerful motorized legs to let gamers dial in their fit whether they’re sitting cozy in a chair or standing up, alert and ready to game.”
paragraphs.cn: Magnus Pro同样是我们首选的游戏专用桌。用IGN评测者Mark Knapp的话说，最新型号「将初代桌款的金属桌面和灵活理线设计，与强劲的电动桌腿结合起来，让玩家无论是舒适地坐在椅子上，还是站起身来准备游戏，都能调节到适合自己的状态」。

paragraphs.en: Like the chair, the K/DA edition is covered in smokey flames and the Firestarter insignia. The desk itself starts at $978 directly through Secretlab , which also offers matching hot pink cable management systems at an additional cost.
paragraphs.cn: 和电竞椅一样，K/DA特别版电竞桌也覆盖着烟雾状火焰与《Firestarter》标志。该桌款通过Secretlab直接购买时起售价为978美元(约合人民币6533元)，官网还提供配套的亮粉色理线系统，但需额外付费。

paragraphs.en: The launch is accompanied by a new illustration showing the K/DA members in their Firestarter looks working on new music with the Secretlab battlestations:
paragraphs.cn: 新品发布的同时还公布了一张全新插画，展现了身穿《Firestarter》造型的K/DA成员使用Secretlab战位创作新音乐的场景：

paragraphs.en: Rumors began circulating of K/DA’s return when the virtual girl group reactivated their social accounts after six years of silence. The rumors were proven true when a new single titled “Firestarter” dropped in mid-October with a music video animated by long-time Riot Games collaborator Fortiche.
paragraphs.cn: 这支虚拟女团沉寂六年后重新启用社交账号，K/DA即将回归的传闻也随之流传开来。10月中旬，一首名为《Firestarter》的新单曲发布，音乐视频由Riot Games的长期合作伙伴Fortiche负责动画制作，传闻最终得到证实。

paragraphs.en: A full EP with the same title was dropped on music streaming services last night. K/DA will also be returning to the stage as the opener for this year's League of Legends World Championship , generally known as Worlds.
paragraphs.cn: 昨晚，同名完整EP已登陆各大音乐流媒体平台。K/DA还将重返舞台，担任今年《英雄联盟》全球总决赛的开场表演嘉宾，该赛事通常被称为Worlds。
